About Obby Rainbow Parkour Two Player

Jump, run, and overcome colorful parkour obstacles in Obby Rainbow Parkour Two Player! Play alone or team up with a friend and complete challenging obstacle courses together.Move through colorful rainbow levels, avoid tricky obstacles, make precise jumps, and reach the finish line. Can you and your friend complete every level?

How to play

Use W A S D to move middot Use SPACE to jump middot Use SHIFT to sprint middot Use Q to shove Use Arrow Key to move middot Use L to jump middot Use SHIFT to sprint middot Use to shove
